g.text: Pasted, never calculated. Only a few columns of each export are used; the rest are shown grey.

rect.data-description: BC EXPORT (pasted). Sheet Sales History. BC Posted Sales Invoice Lines, 203,445 rows, posting dates 5/2 to 9/23/2026. About 145 MB, roughly 91% of the file. Only about 20% of the rows fall inside the 4-week window.
BC EXPORT (pasted). Item number. Feeds: DSD_DSnD Sun/Mon to Fri/Sat, the SUMIFS item criterion.
BC EXPORT (pasted). Feeds: the same SUMIFS, matched to the sample dates in 'Daily Supply & Demand'!H3:M3 minus 0, 7, 14 and 21 days.
BC EXPORT (pasted). Packs sold. Summed by the DSD_DSnD demand formulas.

NOT USED. Document No., Sell-to Customer No., Sell-to Customer Name, Type, Description, Gen. Bus. Posting Group, Gen. Prod. Posting Group, Pc Code, Dept Code, Unit of Measure Code, Unit Price Excl. Tax, Amount, Amount Including Tax, Line Discount %.
BC EXPORT (pasted). Sheet Open Sales Lines. BC Sales Lines (open orders), 1,438 rows, shipment dates 9/22 to 9/24.
BC EXPORT (pasted). Feeds: Dist_DSnD order grids (SUMIFS item), DSD or DIST, pivot rows.
BC EXPORT (pasted). Feeds: Dist_DSnD order grids 0_Sun to 2_Sat.
BC EXPORT (pasted). Feeds: order grids (matched to the row 284 dates), pivot columns.
BC EXPORT (pasted). Feeds: the Dist Shipping Schedule pivot values.
BC EXPORT (pasted). Sell-to Customer Name (D), Document No. (B), Description (G) are pivot row and column fields only.
FORMULA (this sheet). Formula: =IF([@No.]="","",IF(LEFT([@No.],2)="F5","DIST","DSD")). Feeds: the pivot page filter (DIST).
NOT USED. Document Type, Sell-to Customer No., Type, Location Code, Reserve, Reserved Qty. (Base), Unit of Measure Code, Line Amount Excl. Tax.
BC EXPORT (pasted). Sheet DoughWeights, columns O:AJ. BC Quantity Explosion of BOM report, 15,118 rows. Header says As of 03/24/26.
BC EXPORT (pasted). Dough D-code the exploded line belongs to. Feeds: Dough Weight SUMIFS criterion.
BC EXPORT (pasted). Pounds of each component line, every BOM level. Summed into Dough Weight (lb per bag).

NOT USED. AsOfCalcDate, CompanyName, TodayFormatted, ItemTableCaptionFilter, ItemFilter, Desc_Item, the caption columns, BomCompLevelNo, BomCompLevelDesc, FormatLevel, BomCompLevelQty, BomCompLevelUOMCode, Column1.
FORMULA (this sheet). 'Mix-Slice-Oven'!ZZ7 =SUMIF(DoughWeights!T:T,'Mix-Slice-Oven'!$H382:$H382,DoughWeights!AF:AF) reads BOMQty by whole column. Scratch work; nothing reads it.

NOT USED. Business Central Items List, 16 columns, 1,244 rows. No live formula reads it. Only DSD_DSnD Gen. Prod.'s stored table formula points here, so it would come back if that column were refilled.
NOT USED. Static text, unreferenced.
NOT USED. Static values, unreferenced.
INPUT (typed). At least 21 days before the anchor week plus the sample week, so all four same-weekday samples exist.
INPUT (typed). Type the new planning Sunday. H3:M3 and every demand average follow.
INPUT (typed). Then refresh the Dist Shipping Schedule pivot.
INPUT (typed). Row 284 dates above each 0_/1_/2_ grid. They must be real dates, not text.
INPUT (typed). Paste the Quantity Explosion of BOM into DoughWeights O:AJ; Dough Weight recalculates.
INPUT (typed). Pick the production day on Mix-Slice-Oven K4, then confirm Recon shows no Array longer.
ISSUE. As of 03/24/26. Any BOM change since then is missing from Dough Weight and every bag count.
ISSUE. The last labels sit one column off the data: BomCompLevelQty holds a dot, BomCompLevelUOMCode holds the quantity and Column1 holds the unit (LB). The BOMQty column itself is correct.
ISSUE. Sun/Mon samples 9/14, 9/7, 8/31, 8/24. 9/7 was Labor Day with near-zero sales, pulling the Monday average down by up to a quarter.

rect.data-title: Sales History is 91% of the file
rect.data-description: ISSUE. 145 MB of rows, 80% of them outside the window. Trim to the last 5 weeks before pasting.
